name: French horn (VSCO-2 CE + University of Iowa MIS)
license: CC0 1.0 (VSCO-2 CE, C2-C4) + University of Iowa MIS free-use statement (D#4-F5)
attribution: VSCO-2 CE by Versilian Studios LLC (horn C2-C4); University of Iowa Electronic Music Studios Musical Instrument Samples, horn played by Jessica Wiskus (D#4-F5)
notes: French horn, straight sustain, mf, mono. C2-C4 come from VSCO-2 CE (8 notes, room mics); D#4-F5 come from the University of Iowa MIS (6 notes, anechoic, notes ~2.5 s long) because VSCO-2 CE has no horn sustain samples between C4 and D5. Both halves are loudness-matched; the upper half is drier and a little brighter, so a touch of reverb on the whole patch blends them. Every file has a sustain loop (the F5 loop needed a slight level-drift correction). Recommended release 0.25 s.
